question: Why does the herd of deer bow to the five-faced lord?
premises: The deer herd bows to the deity.
The bowing is for obtaining grace.
The herd has cast off pride.
inference: Humble devotion from the animal realm seeks the grace of the five-faced lord.
plain_english: The herd of deer, having cast off pride, bows to you, the five-faced lord, seeking your grace.
